# Muxr

> Muxr is a mobile app for iPhone, iPad and Android phones and tablets that attaches to remote zellij and herdr terminal-multiplexer sessions through muxrd, a self-hosted server daemon you run on your own machine. It connects over TLS with token authentication and QR pairing.

- Platforms: iPhone, iPad, Android phones and tablets
- Supported multiplexers: zellij and herdr
- How it connects: the app talks to muxrd, a self-hosted server daemon, over TLS with token authentication and QR pairing
- Price: Muxr is free to download with one server included. Muxr Pro is a one-time $19.99 purchase, 50% off ($9.99) until January 13, 2027.
- Licence: source available. The server (muxr-core) and the app (muxr-app) are both under the PolyForm Shield License 1.0.0: free for any use, including at work, except to provide a competing product
- Publisher: F0X IT LLC
- Coming soon: tmux support, push notifications, voice input and desktop apps
- Not to be confused with: Muxr by F0X IT LLC (muxr.app) is a zellij and herdr client and is unrelated to the npm package @trymuxr/cli at trymuxr.com.

## Comparisons

- [Comparisons](https://muxr.app/compare/index.html.md): Muxr next to SSH terminals, multiplexer clients and agent remote controls
- [Muxr vs Moshi](https://muxr.app/compare/moshi.html.md): self-hosted daemon or SSH terminal
- [Muxr vs Zelmux](https://muxr.app/compare/zelmux.html.md): two zellij clients
- [Muxr vs Termius](https://muxr.app/compare/termius.html.md): zellij client or SSH manager
- [Muxr vs Blink Shell](https://muxr.app/compare/blink-shell.html.md): zellij and herdr on iOS
- [Muxr vs the zellij web client](https://muxr.app/compare/zellij-web-client.html.md): the browser client that ships with zellij
- [Muxr vs an SSH app running zellij attach](https://muxr.app/compare/ssh-and-zellij.html.md): a general SSH app with zellij on the server
- [Muxr vs the Herdr mobile app](https://muxr.app/compare/herdr-mobile.html.md): the herdr project's own app
- [Muxr vs Claude Code Remote Control](https://muxr.app/compare/claude-code-remote-control.html.md): a terminal client or a vendor's agent remote control
